scenes.description: Donating Warm Blankets and Toys to the Neighborhood Drive
Brave Kid and Benny Wearing Helmets Safely on Scooters
Enjoying a Simple Sweet Picnic on the Sunny Grassland

character_line.en: Our town is collecting toys for families who need help! What can we share?
character_line.zh: 我們鎮上正在為需要幫助的家庭募集玩具！我們可以分享什麼？

options.en: We can give warm blankets and share kind love!
options.zh: 我們可以捐贈溫暖毛毯，分享親切的愛心！

options.hint: 親切善良是「kind」，熱心助人傳遞愛心喔！
表達樂意伸出援手幫助需要的家庭！

character_line.en: Helping others is so heartwarming! Does giving make our hearts rich in joy?
character_line.zh: 幫助別人真令人心頭一暖！付出是不是讓心靈充滿富足的喜悅？

options.en: Yes! Being kind makes everyone rich in happiness!
options.zh: 是的！心懷善意讓大家都在幸福中變得富足！

options.hint: 心靈富足用形容詞「rich（豐富、富有的）」喔！
贊同付出愛心帶來無比的快樂與幸福！

character_line.en: Look at that gentle scooter slope in the park! Are you ready to try?
character_line.zh: 看公園裡那個平緩的滑板車小斜坡！你準備好嘗試了嗎？

options.en: I am brave! I wear my helmet and ride safely!
options.zh: 我很勇敢！我戴好安全帽，而且騎得很安全！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 你很勇敢，而且會注意安全！

character_line.en: Wearing helmets keeps our heads safe! Safety comes first, right?
character_line.zh: 戴安全帽能保護頭部安全！安全第一對不對？

options.en: Yes! Staying safe lets us have the best fun!
options.zh: 沒錯！保持安全能讓我們玩得最開心！

options.hint: 保持安全可以用「Staying safe」喔！
安全才能玩得開心又放心！

character_line.en: We don't need fancy things! Just bread, water, and sunshine on the grass!
character_line.zh: 我們不需要華麗鋪張的東西！草地上只有麵包、水和陽光！

options.en: A simple picnic with you is my favorite thing!
options.zh: 跟你一起度過簡單樸實的野餐是我最喜歡的事！

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 簡單的幸福就是最棒的陪伴！

character_line.en: Being kind, brave, and enjoying simple joys makes every day golden!
character_line.zh: 保持善良、勇敢，並享受簡單的喜悅，讓每一天都金光閃閃！

options.en: I agree! Kindness and courage make our world bright!
options.zh: 我贊同！善良與勇氣讓我們的世界無比明亮！

options.hint: 贊同善良與勇氣帶來美好「Kindness and courage...」喔！
跟 Benny 一起約定做個善良又勇敢的好孩子！
